purpose: Single source for chooser labels, backend capability, delivery formats and acceptance evidence.

status_vocabulary.manual_visual_review: A named output was opened and visually reviewed; this does not imply native-editor or domain approval.
status_vocabulary.rendered_visual_check: The backend rendered and its geometric/text checks passed; human review may still be pending.
status_vocabulary.generated_with_semantic_validation: The input passed the backend's structural, relationship or arithmetic checks before rendering.
status_vocabulary.example_available: A model input exists, but the backend or quality claim is not complete.
status_vocabulary.planned: The chooser entry is useful as a named form, but no directly verified renderer is registered yet.

why.zh: 单一父子层级，适合组织、课程体系、任务拆解
why.en: One parent per item: organizations, curricula, work breakdowns

minimum_input.zh: 节点、父子关系、层级
minimum_input.en: Nodes, parent links, levels

layout_limits.zh: 最多六层；高分支或长文拆成局部详图。
layout_limits.en: Up to six levels; split high-branching or long-text trees into detail views.

detail.zh: 中英思维导图通过树关系、内容保留、自适应下排总览和阅读页检查。
detail.en: Chinese and English mind maps pass tree relations, content retention, adaptive down-layout overview and reading-view checks.

scope.zh: 自适应树布局与稳定 ID；不自动推断组织事实。
scope.en: Adaptive tree layout with stable IDs; organizational facts are never inferred.

why.zh: 看系统有哪些层和模块，以及明确的调用关系
why.en: Show layers, components, and explicit calls between them

minimum_input.zh: 层、模块、连接方向
minimum_input.en: Layers, components, directed links

layout_limits.zh: 每层最多六个模块；横切能力单列侧轨，密集架构拆总览与详图。
layout_limits.en: Up to six modules per layer; put cross-cutting concerns on a side rail and split dense architecture views.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业四层架构和三项横向关注点已完成自适应排版、阅读页与浏览器复核。
detail.en: Bilingual cross-industry four-layer architecture with three cross-cutting concerns has adaptive layout, reading pages and browser review.

scope.zh: 区分包含、调用和横切支撑；不把层级线自动解释成调用。
scope.en: Separates containment, calls and cross-cutting support; layer placement never invents a call.

why.zh: 多对多连接，适合人物、应用、依赖或知识关系
why.en: Many-to-many links between people, apps, dependencies, or concepts

minimum_input.zh: 对象、关系类型、方向
minimum_input.en: Objects, link types, direction

layout_limits.zh: 关系密度高时按群组拆图；边标签必须短且有语义。
layout_limits.en: Split dense relationships by group; edge labels must be short and semantic.

detail.zh: 中英关系网络通过稳定节点与关系、零连接交叉、标签空间、可读字号和浏览器复核。
detail.en: Chinese and English relationship networks pass stable nodes and links, zero connector crossings, label space, readable projected text and browser review.

scope.zh: 保留显式方向和关系类型；不从邻近位置推断关系。
scope.en: Preserves explicit direction and relationship type; proximity never implies a link.

why.zh: 有顺序、判断、异常回流的过程
why.en: Ordered steps with decisions and exception loops

minimum_input.zh: 步骤、分支条件、回流终点
minimum_input.en: Steps, branch labels, loop targets

layout_limits.zh: 分支和回流必须有文字条件；复杂流程用总览加局部关系图。
layout_limits.en: Label branch and return conditions; use overview plus local relationship pages for complex flows.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业流程通过六个步骤、两条判断分支、虚线补充回流、几何检查和浏览器复核。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry flows pass six steps, two decision branches, a dashed update loop, geometry checks and browser review.

scope.zh: 保留前进与返回方向；不为排版改变真实回路。
scope.en: Preserves forward and return direction; real loops are never changed for layout.

why.zh: 重点是每一步由谁执行，以及交接点
why.en: Show who performs each step and where handoffs occur

minimum_input.zh: 角色、步骤、交接、分支
minimum_input.en: Roles, steps, handoffs, branches

layout_limits.zh: 泳道边界需承担责任语义；高密度交接拆局部。
layout_limits.en: Lane boundaries carry ownership semantics; split dense handoffs into detail views.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业泳道通过三条责任泳道、八条显式交接/回流、几何检查和浏览器复核。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry swimlanes pass three responsibility lanes, eight explicit handoff/return links, geometry checks and browser review.

scope.zh: 交接、前台/后台和支撑关系必须显式；不把普通流程换色称为服务蓝图。
scope.en: Handoffs and front/backstage support must be explicit; a recolored flow is not a service blueprint.

why.zh: 重点是参与者之间消息的先后顺序
why.en: Show the order of messages between participants

minimum_input.zh: 参与者、消息、调用顺序
minimum_input.en: Participants, messages, order

layout_limits.zh: 参与者 2–8 个；复杂循环和并发需拆局部交互。
layout_limits.en: Two to eight participants; split complex loops and concurrency into local interaction views.

detail.zh: 中英时序通过参与者与消息拓扑、六步顺序、三条返回虚线、几何检查和浏览器复核。
detail.en: Chinese and English sequences pass actor/message topology, six-step order, three dashed returns, geometry checks and browser review.

scope.zh: 返回消息保留虚线与方向；不把静态架构当动态交互。
scope.en: Return messages retain their dashed direction; static architecture is not treated as interaction.

sub.zh: 发生时间、持续时间、任务依赖
sub.en: When, how long, what depends on what

why.zh: 展示事件发生在什么时间，重点是先后位置
why.en: Place events on real dates in chronological order

minimum_input.zh: 事件、真实日期
minimum_input.en: Events and actual dates

layout_limits.zh: 日期必须递增且唯一；日期比例不能被装饰性间距替代。
layout_limits.en: Dates must be unique and increasing; decorative spacing cannot replace date scale.

detail.zh: 中英时间线通过日期递增、真实日间距、长英文卡片高度、内容保留和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English timelines pass increasing dates, actual day spacing, measured long-English card heights, content retention and browser review.

scope.zh: 表达真实日期顺序；不把方向性路线图宣称为日历排期。
scope.en: Expresses real date order; a directional roadmap is not called a calendar schedule.

why.zh: 展示任务跨度、阶段和进度
why.en: Show task durations, phases, and progress

minimum_input.zh: 任务、开始/结束日期、进度
minimum_input.en: Tasks, start/end dates, progress

layout_limits.zh: 自然日比例、依赖端点和进度分开表达；关键路径不自动计算。
layout_limits.en: Natural-day scale, dependency endpoints and progress are separate; critical path is not calculated.

detail.zh: 中英同一份跨行业任务真值生成汇报、执行、打印三版；日期、进度、依赖和里程碑已做浏览器复核。
detail.en: Executive, delivery and print views are generated from shared Chinese/English cross-industry task truth; dates, progress, dependencies and milestone were browser-reviewed.

scope.zh: 适合已知日期的执行计划；路线方向和关键路径需另行声明。
scope.en: For dated execution plans; directional roadmaps and critical paths require separate declarations.

why.zh: 先后约束比日期更重要
why.en: Task precedence matters more than calendar dates

minimum_input.zh: 任务、前置关系；计算需工期
minimum_input.en: Tasks, predecessor links; durations for calculations

layout_limits.zh: 依赖边必须有前置与后置 ID；有工期计算需求时改用 PERT/CPM 后端。
layout_limits.en: Dependency edges need predecessor and successor IDs; use the PERT/CPM backend when duration calculation is required.

detail.zh: 中英依赖图通过有向无环拓扑、并行汇合、零连接交叉、可读字号和浏览器复核。
detail.en: Chinese and English dependency graphs pass acyclic topology, parallel merge, zero connector crossings, readable projected text and browser review.

scope.zh: 只表达已声明的先后关系；不从图形邻近推断关键路径。
scope.en: Expresses declared precedence only; proximity never implies a critical path.

sub.zh: 大小排序、趋势、前后差异

why.zh: 比较类别大小，尤其适合较长标签
why.en: Compare category magnitudes, especially with long labels

minimum_input.zh: 类别、数值、单位
minimum_input.en: Categories, values, units

layout_limits.zh: 保留单位和零基准；负值与正值不能混成无零轴排序。
layout_limits.en: Retain units and a meaningful baseline; signed values must not become a zero-free ranking.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业条形图通过数值、单位、长英文标签换行和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry bars pass value/unit checks, long-English wrapping and browser review.

scope.zh: 适合类别比较；不把条形图的长度当成统计显著性。
scope.en: For category comparison; bar length is not statistical significance.

why.zh: 连续时间里的变化方向与波动
why.en: Show direction and variation across ordered time

minimum_input.zh: 时间、数值、单位
minimum_input.en: Time points, values, units

layout_limits.zh: 真实日期按间隔定位；缺测保留断点，不能顺手补成零。
layout_limits.en: Use actual date spacing; preserve missing values as breaks rather than turning them into zero.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业趋势图通过等距周标签、单位、原始数值和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry trends pass equal interval labels, units, raw values and browser review.

scope.zh: 表达时间顺序和波动；不把平滑线说成预测。
scope.en: Expresses time order and variation; a smoothing line is not a forecast.

why.zh: 同一对象的两次测量，突出差值
why.en: Compare two measurements for each entity and show change

minimum_input.zh: 对象、前值、后值、单位
minimum_input.en: Entities, before/after values, units

layout_limits.zh: 最多七个对象；保留绝对差值和方向，超过密度拆分。
layout_limits.en: Up to seven entities; retain absolute change and direction, and split higher density.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业前后哑铃通过成对数值、单位、长英文对象名换行和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry dumbbells pass paired values, units, long-English entity wrapping and browser review.

scope.zh: 同一对象的前后变化；不用于独立样本比较。
scope.en: For paired before/after entities; not for independent-group comparison.

why.zh: 把一个总量从基期到期末的增减来源按顺序拆开
why.en: Break an opening-to-closing total into ordered signed changes

minimum_input.zh: 基期、带符号变化项、单位与计量刻度
minimum_input.en: Opening value, signed changes, unit and measurement quantum

layout_limits.zh: 最多七个增减项；首尾总量和每个有符号变化都要保留，超过密度拆分。
layout_limits.en: Up to seven signed changes; keep opening, closing and every step, and split higher density.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业瀑布图通过基期/期末核算、符号增减、刻度、长英文说明和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry waterfalls pass opening/closing reconciliation, signed steps, quantum, long-English notes and browser review.

scope.zh: 表达一个总量的增减分解；不从分解自动推断因果或显著性。
scope.en: Expresses one total's change account; it does not infer causality or significance from the decomposition.

why.zh: 少量类别组成同一个整体
why.en: A few categories sum to one whole

minimum_input.zh: 各部分数值、总量口径
minimum_input.en: Part values and definition of total

layout_limits.zh: 最多五个类别且总量为正；类别过多改用条形图。
layout_limits.en: Up to five positive categories; use bars when there are more categories.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业环图通过互斥构成、总量、长图例换行和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry donuts pass exclusive composition, totals, long-legend wrapping and browser review.

scope.zh: 只在部分构成同一整体时使用；不把角度差当精确读数。
scope.en: Use only when parts share one whole; do not make angle differences carry exact readings.

why.zh: 在同一量纲下快速看出行列交叉的高低与空档
why.en: Scan high, low and missing pockets across a shared row-column scale

minimum_input.zh: 行标签、列标签、同一量纲的数值矩阵、色阶范围
minimum_input.en: Row labels, column labels, a same-unit value grid and scale bounds

layout_limits.zh: 建议 2–8 行、2–10 列；所有格子共享色阶并直接显示数值，密集时拆分。
layout_limits.en: Use roughly 2–8 rows and 2–10 columns; share one scale and show values directly, splitting dense grids.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业热力图通过矩阵尺寸、固定色阶、数值保留和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry heatmaps pass matrix dimensions, fixed scale, value retention and browser review.

scope.zh: 颜色只编码已声明的数值高低；不从色块邻近推断因果或聚类。
scope.en: Colour encodes only the declared values; adjacency never implies causality or clustering.

why.zh: 看连续数值的频数分布，而非类别大小
why.en: Show frequencies of continuous measurements, not category size

minimum_input.zh: 逐条数值、单位、分箱规则
minimum_input.en: Observations, unit, binning rule

layout_limits.zh: 分箱规则需可追溯；连续观测不足时改用点图或表格。
layout_limits.en: Binning must be traceable; use points or a table when continuous observations are sparse.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业直方图通过等宽分箱、观测范围、频数、单位与浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry histograms pass equal-width bins, observation bounds, frequencies, units and browser review.

scope.zh: 表达分布形状；不从一张图自动命名正态或因果。
scope.en: Expresses distribution shape; it does not automatically establish normality or causality.

why.zh: 看两个数值变量之间的关系与离群点
why.en: Inspect two quantitative variables and outliers

minimum_input.zh: 成对观测、X/Y单位
minimum_input.en: Paired observations, X/Y units

layout_limits.zh: 保留观测配对和单位；相关不自动解释为因果。
layout_limits.en: Retain paired observations and units; correlation is not automatically causal.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业散点图通过配对点、固定轴范围、单位、点标签与浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry scatter plots pass paired points, fixed axis ranges, units, point labels and browser review.

scope.zh: 表达成对数值的关系和离群点；不自动画回归结论。
scope.en: Expresses paired values and outliers; it does not invent a regression conclusion.

sub.zh: 组织原因、比较取舍、决定先后

why.zh: 把问题拆成待验证的原因假说，不把分支当作因果证明
why.en: Break a problem into testable cause hypotheses without presenting branches as proof

minimum_input.zh: 结果/问题、原因类别、每类原因；每条都要有验证状态
minimum_input.en: Effect or problem, cause categories and causes; each remains a hypothesis to verify

layout_limits.zh: 原因类别 2–6 个，每类最多 3 条；英文和长文按内容测量，过密时拆页。
layout_limits.en: Two to six categories and up to three causes each; measure long bilingual copy and split dense boards.

detail.zh: 中英示例通过内容保留、长英文换行和几何检查；分支仍是待验证假说。
detail.en: Chinese and English examples pass content retention, long-English wrapping and geometry checks; branches remain hypotheses to verify.

scope.zh: 用于结构化排查，不计算概率、不自动宣称根因。
scope.en: Structures investigation; it does not calculate probabilities or declare a root cause.

why.zh: 用两个明确维度展示取舍和优先验证项
why.en: Show trade-offs and items to validate first on two declared dimensions

minimum_input.zh: 横纵轴含义、四个象限标签、对象与 0–100 坐标来源
minimum_input.en: Axis meanings, four quadrant labels, items and the basis for 0–100 coordinates

layout_limits.zh: 坐标仅表达声明的归一化评分；不把位置自动解释为事实、因果或统计显著性。
layout_limits.en: Coordinates express declared normalised scores; position is not automatically fact, causality or statistical significance.

detail.zh: 中英示例通过轴、象限、对象坐标、内容保留和几何检查；评分依据仍需项目提供。
detail.en: Chinese and English examples pass axes, quadrants, item coordinates, content retention and geometry checks; project scoring basis is still required.

scope.zh: 表达优先级假说，不替代决策记录或实际评分流程。
scope.en: Expresses a prioritisation hypothesis; it does not replace decision records or scoring workflow.

sub.zh: 判断方向、安排工作、看见流动
sub.en: Choose direction, organise work and see flow

why.zh: 把内部能力、限制与外部机会、风险分开，形成待验证的战略假说
why.en: Separate internal capabilities and limits from external opportunities and threats as hypotheses to test

minimum_input.zh: 四类因素、每类条目、证据或待验证标记
minimum_input.en: Four factors, items in each factor and evidence or open-question markers

layout_limits.zh: 四类各最多 5 条；每条写成可讨论的事实、假说或问题，内容密集时拆成策略与证据两页。
layout_limits.en: Up to five items per factor; state facts, hypotheses or questions explicitly and split dense evidence into a second page.

detail.zh: 中英 SWOT 示例通过内容保留、四格几何检查和浏览器查看；条目仍需领域证据。
detail.en: Chinese and English SWOT examples pass content retention, four-cell geometry checks and browser review; items still need domain evidence.

scope.zh: 用于组织战略讨论，不自动计算优势权重、概率或决策结论。
scope.en: Organises strategy discussion; it does not calculate weights, probabilities or a decision conclusion.

why.zh: 把工作项、状态、工作类型、WIP 和阻塞放在同一块可读的流动板上
why.en: Show work items, states, work classes, WIP and blockers on one readable flow board

minimum_input.zh: 状态列、工作类型泳道、卡片、负责人、WIP 限制、拉动条件和显式策略
minimum_input.en: State columns, work-class lanes, cards, owners, WIP limits, pull criteria and explicit policies

layout_limits.zh: 单板 3–7 列、2–5 条泳道；每格最多 4 张卡，阻塞项继续计入 WIP，实时历史轨迹和 CFD 另行实现。
layout_limits.en: One board with 3–7 columns and 2–5 lanes; up to four cards per cell, with blockers counted in WIP; history and CFD are separate work.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业看板通过列/泳道 WIP、阻塞、双语界面标签、SVG 与 draw.io 生成和浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry boards pass column/lane WIP, blocker, bilingual UI-label, SVG/draw.io generation and browser review.

scope.zh: 表达声明的当前工作流，不是实时工单系统、自动排程、人员绩效排名或历史流量分析。
scope.en: Expresses the declared current workflow; it is not a live ticket system, scheduler, performance ranking or historical flow analysis.

why.zh: 展示一个过程从入口到完成如何逐阶段收窄，适合转化、筛选和服务完成路径
why.en: Show how one process narrows from entry to completion: conversion, screening and service completion

minimum_input.zh: 按顺序排列的阶段、每阶段人数或数量、单位与口径
minimum_input.en: Ordered stages, a count for each stage, unit and measurement scope

layout_limits.zh: 阶段数量 2–6；人数必须为正且不递增；漏斗宽度表达数量比例，不表达统计显著性或因果。
layout_limits.en: Use 2–6 stages; counts must be positive and nonincreasing; width encodes proportion, not significance or causality.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业漏斗通过正数/不递增约束、阶段文字保留、按内容测量与浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry funnels pass positive/nonincreasing constraints, stage-text retention, measured layout and browser review.

scope.zh: 表达声明的阶段数量和口径，不自动解释流失原因、转化率显著性或业务结论。
scope.en: Expresses declared stage counts and scope; it does not infer drop-off causes, significance or business conclusions.

why.zh: 把伙伴、活动、资源、价值、客户、渠道、成本和收入放在同一张可讨论的假说画布上
why.en: Place partners, activities, resources, value, customers, channels, costs and revenue on one hypothesis canvas

minimum_input.zh: 九个固定要素、每格条目、假说或证据状态
minimum_input.en: The nine fixed blocks, entries in each block, and hypothesis or evidence status

layout_limits.zh: 固定九格；每格保持短条目，长内容拆成验证页；不把画布当作商业事实或财务模型。
layout_limits.en: Keep the nine blocks; split long entries into a validation page; the canvas is not a business fact or financial model.

detail.zh: 中英跨行业画布通过九格位置、条目/详情保留、英文长文换行与浏览器查看。
detail.en: Chinese and English cross-industry canvases pass nine-block placement, entry/detail retention, English wrapping and browser review.

scope.zh: 整理待验证的商业假说，不计算市场规模、定价、收入预测或战略优先级。
scope.en: Organises business hypotheses to validate; it does not calculate market size, pricing, revenue forecasts or strategic priority.

sub.zh: 归纳、体验、复盘与交付切片

why.zh: 把原始观察归组，保留少数意见
why.en: Group observations while keeping minority feedback visible

minimum_input.zh: 观察原文、来源、主题归属；不得把条数当发生率
minimum_input.en: Original observations, sources and themes; counts are not prevalence

layout_limits.zh: 每条观察必须唯一归组；内容多时拆主题或详页。
layout_limits.en: Every observation has one assignment; split themes or detail pages when dense.

detail.zh: 中英案例均检查分组完整性、唯一归属、来源保留和 SVG 阅读；不输出 draw.io。
detail.en: Chinese and English cases pass grouping completeness, single assignment, source retention and SVG reading checks; draw.io is not exported.

scope.zh: 保留来源、少数意见和待确认项；不生成投票或频率事实。
scope.en: Retains sources, minority feedback and open items; it does not invent votes or prevalence.

why.zh: 按用户阶段追踪体验，区分证据与改进假说
why.en: Follow user stages and separate evidence from hypotheses

minimum_input.zh: 用户、目标、阶段、触点、证据、机会；缺少情绪数据不编分数
minimum_input.en: Persona, goal, stages, touchpoints, evidence, opportunities; no invented emotion scores

layout_limits.zh: 阶段 2–8 个；保留行为、触点、证据、机会和行动追踪，长文拆阶段或详页。
layout_limits.en: Two to eight stages; retain behavior, touchpoint, evidence, opportunity and action trace; split dense maps.

detail.zh: 中英案例通过阶段、证据、机会、行动引用、内容保留和浏览器文字检查。
detail.en: Chinese and English cases pass stage, evidence, opportunity, action-reference, content-preservation and browser text checks.

scope.zh: 情绪必须有依据，不编造分数；机会回链证据，行动回链机会。
scope.en: Emotion needs a basis and never becomes an invented score; opportunities trace to evidence and actions trace to opportunities.

why.zh: 把用户、前台、后台、支撑和系统记录放在同一服务链上
why.en: Place customer, frontstage, backstage, support and system records on one service chain

minimum_input.zh: 服务阶段、3–6 条语义泳道、每格动作、分界线与交接
minimum_input.en: Service stages, 3–6 semantic lanes, cell actions, boundaries and handoffs

layout_limits.zh: 阶段 2–8 个、泳道 3–6 条；只绘制输入声明的分界线和交接，不从相邻位置推断。
layout_limits.en: Two to eight stages and three to six lanes; draw only declared boundaries and handoffs, never infer from adjacency.

detail.zh: 中英案例通过泳道、分界线、交接端点、内容保留和浏览器文字检查。
detail.en: Chinese and English cases pass lane, boundary, handoff-endpoint, content-preservation and browser text checks.

scope.zh: 表达服务协作语义，不等于实时服务蓝图软件或流程执行系统。
scope.en: Expresses service collaboration semantics; it is not a live blueprint workspace or process execution system.

why.zh: 把讨论转成行动，也保留未解决分歧
why.en: Turn discussion into follow-up while preserving unresolved questions

minimum_input.zh: 观察、停止/开始/继续、拟议动作、负责人、复核日期与验收方式
minimum_input.en: Observations, stop/start/continue, proposed actions, owners, review dates and checks

layout_limits.zh: 行动字段不能遮住观察和分歧；多项行动分拆为局部板。
layout_limits.en: Actions must not obscure observations or disagreement; split boards with many actions.

detail.zh: 中英营销复盘表已生成并查看，英文拉丁词按空格换行；无实时会议、投票或协作功能。
detail.en: Chinese and English retrospective tables were generated and viewed; English Latin words wrap at spaces; live meeting, voting and collaboration are not implemented.

scope.zh: 区分观察、推断、行动和验收；未确认意见保持开放。
scope.en: Separates observations, inferences, actions and checks; unconfirmed opinions remain open.

why.zh: 用户活动横向展开，用交付切片界定每次可用范围
why.en: Arrange user activities horizontally and define usable release slices

minimum_input.zh: 用户与目标、活动顺序、故事 ID、交付切片及其目标；切片不是日期比例
minimum_input.en: Persona and goal, ordered activities, story IDs, release slices and outcomes; slices are not a time scale

layout_limits.zh: 每条故事唯一归属活动和切片；长文纵向扩展，多活动横向扩展。
layout_limits.en: Each story belongs to one activity and slice; long text grows downward and more activities widen the map.

detail.zh: 40 项回归、浏览器文字检查和 draw.io 编辑保存重开通过。
detail.en: Forty regressions, browser text checks and draw.io edit/save/reopen passed.

scope.zh: 表达活动与交付范围，不计算日期、依赖或投票。
scope.en: Expresses activities and release scope; it does not calculate dates, dependencies or votes.
